core_obligations: Reduce to locally quasi-finite using that quasi-compact is fpqc local on the base (lemma-descending-property-quasi-compact) (proof lines 2011-2015).

Set up the framework lemma: its assumptions (1) and (2) follow from the cited locality lemma for locally quasi-finite morphisms; choose the surjective \'etale chart U \to X and, by the same locality lemma, reduce to showing U \to Z is locally quasi-finite; from f' locally quasi-finite and Z' \times_Z U \'etale over Z' \times_Z X conclude Z' \times_Z U \to Z' is locally quasi-finite (proof lines 2015-2028).
Conclude U \to Z is locally quasi-finite by the scheme-side fpqc descent lemma applied to the covering {Z' \to Z} (proof lines 2028-2033).
proof_roadmap: Split the statement using the known descent of quasi-compactness.
Move local quasi-finiteness to the \'etale charts over Z and Z'.
Descend along the fpqc covering with the scheme-side lemma.
difficulty_reason: The proof first reduces the pair of properties: quasi-compactness is already known fpqc local on the base (cited earlier lemma), so it suffices to treat locally quasi-finite. Then it runs the chart-reduction: the framework lemma's assumptions hold by the cited \'etale-locality lemma; local quasi-finiteness is moved to the \'etale charts (U \to Z and Z' \times_Z U \to Z'), and the scheme-side fpqc descent lemma concludes. The reduction of quasi-finite to the local property plus quasi-compactness and the chart transport are the substance.
